meanPredict_prefix: theorem meanPredict_prefix (y z : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℕ) (h : ∀ i < t, y i = z i) : meanPredict y t = meanPredict z t
meanPredict_mem: theorem meanPredict_mem (y : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℕ) (hy : ∀ i < t, y i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) : meanPredict y t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1
empiricalMean_update: theorem empiricalMean_update (y : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℕ) (ht : 0 < t) : empiricalMean y (t+1) = empiricalMean y t + (y t - empiricalMean y t) / (t+1)
meanPredict_stability: theorem meanPredict_stability (y : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℕ) (hy : ∀ i ≤ t, y i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) : (meanPredict y t - y t)^2 - (empiricalMean y (t+1) - y t)^2 ≤ 4 / (t+1)
theorem_1_3: theorem theorem_1_3 (y : ℕ → ℝ) (T : ℕ) (hT : 0 < T) (hy : ∀ t < T, y t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) : (∑ t ∈ Finset.range T, (meanPredict y t - y t)^2) - (∑ t ∈ Finset.range T, (empiricalMean y T - y t)^2) ≤ 4 + 4 * Real.log T
